campaign: Deterministic RSI storage, execution, and grounded capability control plane
doctrine: OvergoDB remains the sole canonical artifact transaction authority. Modularization separates a small hash-chained metadata journal, immutable content-addressed blobs, compiled Go projections and checkpoints, and bounded operational coordination while preserving artifact.Repository, global ordering, atomic batches, alias compare-and-set, lineage validation, read-only refresh, backup, retention, and deterministic replay. High-volume observations are chunked into blobs and committed through bounded summaries; heartbeats, wake signals, and partial process output remain operational unless they cause a meaningful durable transition. Multica and semantic-router are used only as independently re-expressed inventories of operational problems and observable behavior: no source, schema, file format, runtime, Markdown skill, plugin mechanism, or product layer is copied. Modern and Marin Overgo source integrations remain subordinate to the same common owners and ratchets; repository, commit, license, path, mechanism, or transform provenance is evidence only and can never grant capability or execution authority. docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan; imported branch plans, roadmaps, design records, staged-surface manifests, and historical Git snapshots are evidence or inventories only and cannot schedule work, satisfy dependencies, or grant completion. RSI uses four shared components rather than domain platforms: one typed and falsifiable cross-domain candidate spine, one evidence-gated promotion and rollback lifecycle, one evidence-driven budget and stop driver, and one transport-neutral UTCP effect, approval, and receipt contract. Model, composition, mechanism, dataset, routing, steering, and code logic enter only as compiled Go candidate-source, realization, or evaluator plugins. AgentTaskContract or DelegatedAgentInvocation provides the task ceiling, active AutomationPolicyLifecycle provides a standing unattended grant within that ceiling, and operatoraction HumanDecision is the argument-bound per-action grant; the shared StageReceipt binds whichever exact authority was consumed. Agent-initiated and cross-process or peer calls may resolve the invocation contract through UTCP transports; deterministic in-process orchestration calls existing Go owners directly and shares only the contract and receipt shape, never the tool transport. Derived decisions are distribution-free where justified and otherwise bind their distribution assumptions, explicit missing-data coverage, and architecture tests that refuse bypasses. One shared sequential-control owner calibrates frozen Phase I incumbent limits and applies them in Phase II with replay-measured in-control run length and shift detection delay on the exact ordered, autocorrelated stream; common-cause or insufficient evidence cannot request lifecycle, budget, or autonomy mutation. The first capability proof is one local same-base composite advanced only to a supervised non-serving verified state while the production incumbent and unattended grant remain unchanged; advanced plugins, optimization, peer transport, rollout, live safety, concurrency, and closure are built from its persisted trace rather than ahead of it. Interaction efficiency is an external behavior: equal or better task capability with fewer semantic commits, journal documents, lineage edges, projection scans, decoded blobs, bytes, wakeups, context repetitions, model turns, capability invocations, approval rounds, tool calls, retries, and waits. Every optimization starts from a measured representative interaction trace, preserves exact admitted inputs and evidence, consolidates common policy or mechanics, and deletes the displaced path in the same commit. Grounded capability learning adapts only the highest-value PentAGI and RAGFlow concepts through existing Go owners: capability episodes are rebuildable projections over exact run-record authority; structural hybrid retrieval remains dataset-owned and emits evidence only when consumed; production probes, evidence-dominant routing, and exact trajectory supervision remain subordinate to typed placement, invocation, lifecycle, and receipt authority; reusable episode knowledge enters only as an admitted immutable dataset transform with independent held-out benefit. No second event log, mutable agent-memory service, provider router, external runtime, vector or graph database, prompt-owned workflow, Markdown skill, copied source, or free threshold is introduced.

items.title: Turn DAG slack into conflict-bound implementation lanes

steps.title: Dispatch exact ready frontiers through role-owned worktree leases and merge gated pruned completions
steps.rationale: Only after the supervised first-win trace proves the single-lane vertical slice, keep Current as the deterministic compatibility selector but expose the complete ordered post-proof ready frontier to role-owned leases with non-overlapping filesystem and resource claims. Concurrent implementation uses distinct worktrees; each worktree gates commits serially, and semantic merge accepts a pruned row only with ancestor gate evidence while preserving dependency order. Scheduling has no runtime capability, transport, approval, or receipt authority. Shared-worktree subagents remain limited to parallel audit, design, and testing.

items.title: Reduce component, agent, tool, peer, and operator interactions without losing admitted work or evidence

steps.title: Normalize high-volume training evidence through one reusable bounded chunk owner
steps.rationale: Start from the exact representative execution and interaction trace persisted by the supervised composite first win, then measure the merged Marin training path and replace per-step and per-layer router documents and whole-run health arrays with one reusable Go chunk mechanic: bounded immutable payload blobs, ordinal and previous linkage, compact typed coverage summaries, and one workflow-owned atomic publication. Preserve every admitted router selection, margin, acceptance, health sample, authority, and explicit missing state under shared fact, chunk, and raw-byte budgets. The metadata journal and head deltas carry summaries and chunk identities only; projections decode no raw blob unless the query contract requests exact samples. Delete or route standalone publication paths through the same owner in this step; no efficiency claim may precede the real loop trace.

steps.title: Route bounded queries through exact compiled indexes and report inspected, matched, returned, and loaded facts
steps.rationale: Kind, media, schema, sequence, alias, lineage, contract, causal, router-coverage, health, scaling, rollout, and candidate-component lookups use their owning compiled projection rather than scanning the catalog. Retrieval construction and exact search both bind fact, memory, intermediate-byte, decode, inspected, and result budgets; resumable index construction publishes through the common projection checkpoint owner, and a missing or stale index refuses an unbounded fallback. Training-evidence queries select summaries by run, model, dataset, split, recipe, and head and load raw chunks only when the exact query contract requests samples. Every result reports inspected, matched, returned, and loaded facts, blobs, and bytes.

steps.title: Serve initial snapshots plus ordered head-bound deltas to read-only peers, runtime views, and the embedded UI
steps.rationale: Consumers receive an initial snapshot followed by ordered canonical deltas naming previous and resulting heads. Training deltas carry compact coverage or aggregate identities, never raw chunk bytes or fan-out copies of child observation IDs. Only commutative view changes coalesce; discontinuity or projector-version mismatch forces a bounded snapshot resync.

steps.title: Reuse content identities and admitted stimulus cursors so resumable sessions receive only new interaction arcs
steps.rationale: Repeated source content is referenced once and later occurrences preserve provenance without duplicating bytes. A runtime capability that proves session continuity may receive only the stable cursor delta; stateless or retired sessions deterministically rebuild the bounded full context. Optimization cannot omit an admitted stimulus.

steps.title: Coalesce wakeups, claims, capability refreshes, and reconciliation work around semantic dirty-state boundaries
steps.rationale: Reconnect flaps, repeated wake signals, duplicate deliveries, and unchanged capability probes produce one pending reconciliation rather than one run each. Claims and reads are batched within existing authority boundaries; every admitted item is processed once or remains visibly pending.

steps.title: Project one causal operation timeline and one pending-decision view for approvals, refusals, retries, quarantine, and rollback
steps.rationale: Project one causal operation timeline and pending-decision view across approvals, refusals, retries, health classifications, MoE evaluation findings, autonomy predicates, quarantine, promotion, and rollback. Each pending mutation shows exact capability, closed mutation kind, effect and targets, canonical argument identity, action-bound inspection, task or delegation ceiling, active AutomationPolicyLifecycle standing grant or argument-bound HumanDecision, and shared StageReceipt state. Domain records contribute immutable evidence only; idempotent actions still execute through the existing experiment-lifecycle, promotion, tool, or operator authority. The projection duplicates no domain state and never turns advisory health or routing evidence into mutation authority.

steps.title: Reject interaction optimizations that lose capability, evidence, determinism, or merely shift work to another component
steps.rationale: Candidate and baseline traces must complete the same task contract with equivalent admitted inputs, router and health facts, missing states, approvals, receipts, and evidence. A win requires a Pareto improvement or explicit tradeoff across semantic commits, journal documents, lineage edges, scans, loaded facts, decoded blobs, bytes, wakeups, repeated context, model turns, local and peer capability invocations, approval rounds, tool calls, retries, waits, wall time, and resource peaks. Ordered benchmark and performance series consume the shared frozen sequential-control plan so common-cause variation cannot fail the gate and adverse special-cause evidence cannot be hidden by aggregation; paired A/B evidence remains direct comparison evidence. Same-process work routed through a tool transport counts as added interaction rather than reuse. One large commit does not hide artifact or decode amplification, and missing counters block the claim.

steps.title: Admit or refuse recipe-bound residual control of tool-call propensity from exact-model Pareto evidence
steps.rationale: Treat residual tool-call control as training-free but distribution- and harness-dependent. Extraction and Pareto evaluation are thin Candidate source and evaluator plugins; they publish a content-addressed ResidualDirection bound to the exact TapLayerInput contract, model and definition, effect-classed UTCP manuals, shared tool-open readout, corpus and split, quantiles, extraction run, and environment, but own no recipe or activation path. This row migrates the existing steering proposal path through the common persisted-Candidate admission entry and removes any direct steering eligibility owner before activation. The shared candidate and recipe spines may activate it only after common admission, compilation, validation, and evaluation, using an alpha derived by a predeclared objective-constrained selector with explicit normalization, target, and tie-break; alpha is never a request knob. A nonzero intervention is admitted only in an inspection-only proposal phase where mutation manuals are masked and every dynamically resolved capability-proxy target is an inspection effect. Any decode exposing mutation or opaque effects runs at alpha zero, and a model format whose shared open token cannot isolate the inspection action space is verification-only. Mutation proposals remain on the unsteered path behind action-bound inspection, task or delegation ceiling, active AutomationPolicyLifecycle standing grant or argument-bound HumanDecision, and shared StageReceipt. Admission also requires alpha-zero identity, signed monotonic realized inspection-call rate, cached and device parity, well-formed proposals, and nondominated quality and cost evidence on the exact harness. Measure inspection proposals and calls, mutation proposals, approval prompts, and admitted, receipted, and executed mutations separately. The intervention can increase looking and verification but can never increase mutation propensity or grant, approve, dispatch, or receipt authority.

items.title: Evaluate every candidate plugin and activate it through one shared promotion lifecycle

steps.title: Publish identity-bound cross-domain performance observations from isolated supervised processes
steps.rationale: Acquire performance evidence in one supervised process or session per exact validated candidate and local recipe. Execute through the existing operation and process-supervision owners after deriving the closed evaluation or training-launch effect, canonical arguments and targets, action-bound preflight inspection, task or delegation ceiling, argument-bound HumanDecision, and shared admitted-running-terminal StageReceipt; no UTCP transport is inserted inward. Bind candidate, resolved model or composition, held-out dataset and split digest, environment, recipe, placement, code, attempt, ResourceFitness, and explicit missing coverage in one semantic publication. Domain summaries may describe derived facts but cannot create comparison, promotion, retry, or rollback authority. Refuse child or cleanup failure, mixed observation scope, stale operation heads, unrelated or argument-drifted preflight evidence, or partial publication. High-volume training, scaling, health, MoE, and expert-parallel evidence are post-proof plugins of this owner.

steps.title: Evaluate candidates and their component ablations while separating model, composition, routing, steering, data, recipe, and system deltas
steps.rationale: One evaluator spine consumes the exact DriverDecision and scores the same-base candidate, production incumbent, parent specialists, joint merge, and predeclared dropped-delta ablations under identical inputs, independent promotion split, budgets, coverage, and multidimensional fitness contract. A capability win requires the predeclared measurable Pareto improvement or explicit accepted tradeoff; a scalarized best score, development-split reuse, missing arm, or regression records refusal. The same evaluator contracts later attribute model, architecture, composition, routing, steering, dataset, recipe, placement, and interaction deltas through plugins rather than siloed comparison stacks. Evaluators emit immutable facts only; a document named promotion cannot mutate any lifecycle or alias.

items.title: Drive admitted and active cross-domain candidates through one evidence-derived budget, saturation, stop, and routing loop

steps.title: Replay recorded driver decisions under a candidate policy and publish measured counterfactual deltas
steps.rationale: Only after the supervised trace exists, replay a candidate driver or domain policy against the recorded DriverDecision corpus with identical inputs, budgets, stop conditions, and fixed evidence identities. For routing changes, reuse exact router-observation coverage, paired baseline arms, declared targets, and homogeneous, mixed, imbalanced, and transition-window strata; hidden-stratum failure or controller lag remains explicit. Publish coverage and deltas without granting live dispatch. Counterfactual evidence becomes an additional rollout input only for the behavior it changes; composition search and calibration extend this owner in their own post-proof step.

items.title: Prove a measurable model capability win before optimizing or widening autonomy

steps.title: Run one same-base composite through admission, realization, held-out evaluation, and supervised non-serving verification
steps.rationale: Close the first vertical RSI slice with exactly one local, already-admitted same-base task-arithmetic candidate. Resolve the production incumbent and every parent definition and tensor inventory; let DriverDecision select the declared realization, promotion-split evaluation, and dropped-delta ablations; bind the exact strategy identity on the attempt; materialize deterministic content-addressed output; and compare the candidate with the unchanged incumbent and parent specialists under the same held-out inputs, budgets, coverage, and multidimensional fitness. A win requires the predeclared measurable Pareto improvement or accepted tradeoff; missing evidence or regression persists a refusal, never a ceremonial success. This is human-watched and non-serving: derive one closed supervised-verification effect with canonical arguments and targets, action-bound preflight evidence, exact task ceiling, and argument-bound HumanDecision; publish admitted, running, and terminal StageReceipt states; and submit only the candidate or experimental to validated or verified compare-and-set to the shared lifecycle. The production active alias and unattended AutomationPolicyLifecycle remain unchanged. Persist Candidate, DriverDecision, strategy-tagged attempt, materialization, evaluation, ablations, HumanDecision, receipt chain, lifecycle transition, and the representative execution and interaction trace in OvergoDB, then cold-reopen and reproduce every identity, result, and incumbent binding. No live traffic, rollout, autonomy widening, peer transport, residual steering, advanced composition, or high-volume training is admitted by this milestone, and it creates no new admission, driver, process, publication, lifecycle, approval, receipt, or promotion owner.

items.title: Add harder composition rungs through the same spines only after the same-base proof

steps.title: Add deterministic component retrieval and one bounded frozen-donor alignment-adapter ladder
steps.rationale: Only after the reproducible held-out same-base win, extend the existing projection with fixed-schema unit-normalized component descriptors, exact deterministic retrieval, content-addressed Procrustes or OT seam evidence, and one bounded donor-to-seam-to-adapter ladder. Freeze donors, train only the interface adapter through bridgetrain, assemble through synthesis, bias-audit the pretraining residual against post-training parity, and require target, composed, dropped-source, and shuffled-source arms under multidimensional fitness. These are Candidate source, realization, and evaluator plugins of the shared spines, not a normalized-catalog service, composition runtime, admission owner, publisher, or lifecycle. HDC and broad cross-architecture search remain refused until exact retrieval is a measured blocker with an explicit reopen trigger.

steps.title: Admit bounded composition search and budget widening only from measured learning and calibration
steps.rationale: Extend the shared DriverDecision only after the alignment ladder exists and generic counterfactual replay can measure it. Derive weakest-domain, regression, and frontier-gap requests from immutable evaluations; aggregate strategy-tagged attempts into held-out fitness delta per compute, candidate hit rate, adapter cost, refusal and saturation history, and predicted-versus-actual calibration without a hidden threshold. A composition budget may widen only after a positive held-out learning curve, calibrated predictions, complete ablations, and beneficial special-cause evidence from the shared frozen sequential-control plan; adverse special cause narrows or stops, while common cause and insufficient evidence preserve the current budget. This step adds no composition loop, free search knob, policy, activation path, or lifecycle authority; any later production request still traverses the shared rollout and promotion adapter.

items.title: Adapt data, routing, scale, health, and architecture mechanisms after the first proven loop

steps.title: Extend candidate compilation and materialization with evidence-gated data, MoE, DenseToMoE, architecture, and expert-placement plugins
steps.rationale: After the simple composite proves the shared loop, migrate Marin mechanism, dataset-transform, routing, DenseToMoE, model-architecture, and expert-placement eligibility through compiled adapters on the persisted-Candidate admission entry, then delete their parallel admission records and private eligibility codecs in the same slice. They remain registered Go Candidate source and realization plugins rather than new control planes. Deterministic data stages bind memory and intermediate-byte budgets, durable stage checkpoints, exact resume, and classified failure. MoE targets and quantile estimates remain evidence-bound; controller code alone changes routing; router semantics stay separate from placement and transport. DenseToMoE is a later architecture-change rung requiring exact screen and expert inventory evidence and cannot self-promote. Expert parallelism refuses without a measured single-device placement, memory, or throughput blocker and one authorized multi-device target. Model-authored predictions retain measured outcome and calibration; frontier mechanisms remain independent candidates with component ablations rather than a bundled label. Plugins reuse and extend the admission ratchet, common compiler, publication, recipe, driver, and lifecycle owners and introduce no distributed platform or scheduler.

steps.title: Extend isolated evaluation with bounded scaling, training-health, router-coverage, and expert-parallel evidence
steps.rationale: Extend the already-proven isolated process and evaluator owners, using the post-proof bounded training-evidence mechanic for raw router and health samples. Bind exact scaling rungs, configurations, seeds, datasets, evaluators, active and measured costs, health phases, controller checkpoints, router scope coverage, assignments, bytes, collectives, topology, sender and receiver overflow, drops, synchronization, and memory. Training-health adapters supply typed ordered statistics to the shared sequential-control owner and consume its evidence; they cannot own windows, persistence, boundaries, or action. Fits refuse extrapolation or regime mixing; effective speedup compares identical observed quality and compatible units; MoE arms include paired baseline, constrained, dropless, shift, and lag cases. Expert-parallel evidence selects at most one bounded transport against the local reference and proves checkpoint and retry recovery. Plugin summaries cannot duplicate raw telemetry or create comparison, promotion, retry, rollback, or lifecycle authority; incomplete coverage or partial publication refuses.

items.title: Use the shared invocation contract for agent-initiated and cross-boundary capability reuse

steps.title: Complete staged delegation and receipted peer capability invocation without routing internal Go through UTCP
steps.rationale: Complete and retire the staged CapabilityProxyManual and RegisterCapabilityProxy, NewDelegatedCoordinator, CompileDelegatedAgentInvocation, and NewMutationCheckpointRuntime surfaces through existing command, server, runtime, approval, execution, and receipt owners. A lane or peer exposes a compiled Go capability as an exact effect-classed UTCP manual; consumers invoke it across the boundary instead of importing or duplicating runtime code. Bind PeerCapabilityPublication, enrollment, heartbeat, compatibility, and placement to the active CatalogSnapshot, Manual, and CapabilityIdentity; recheck publication and lease immediately before bounded no-redirect http-json-stream dispatch; then publish the shared StageReceipt with canonical arguments, effect, targets, inspection, task or delegation ceiling, HumanDecision or active policy, causal context, and head. Remote recipe validation requires that exact manual and placement. Inspection propensity may later be steered only while every resolved capability is inspection-class; mutation stays alpha zero and behind approval. Deterministic in-process orchestration continues to call Go owners directly and never enters UTCP resolution or transport. This adds no second registry, admission, placement, execution, approval, receipt, lifecycle, or policy owner.

items.title: Feed the shared promotion spine with immutable cross-domain rollout and ablation evidence

steps.title: Define one content-addressed rollout plan for any candidate, binding incumbent, cohort, observations, ablations, and rollback authority
steps.rationale: A rollout is evidence for the shared promotion spine, not a mutable feature flag or domain-specific lifecycle. It binds incumbent, composite candidate and component ablations, cohort key, hash version, observation and interaction contract, rollback authority, the frozen sequential-control plan, incumbent Phase I evidence, Phase II series and coverage contract, reopen rule, and plugin-specific evidence requirements. A MoE component additionally binds routing target, exact router coverage, paired baseline and capacity authorities, shift cases, and applicable counterfactual evidence; composition, steering, data, model, and code components bind their own typed evaluator facts through the same plan. Cohort size and boundaries remain derived from evaluation evidence or explicit decisions with reopen triggers.

steps.title: Assign incumbent, candidate, and component-ablation arms deterministically across retry, replay, peer placement, and restart
steps.rationale: Assignment uses a canonical key separator and pinned hash version with golden vectors. Every observation records plan and arm; disabled or ineligible workloads can never leak into the candidate arm.

steps.title: Materialize rollout reports with head, projector version, query contract, source chunk IDs, coverage, and result digest
steps.rationale: Materialize rollout reports from immutable source identities: head, projector version, query contract, observation chunks, bounded MoE router-coverage sets, scaling accounting, training-health classifications, sequential-control plan and result identities, ordered source chunks, coverage, and result digest. The router-coverage and control projection heads are retention or checkpoint identities only, never activation aliases. Promotion and rollback consume immutable reports rather than dashboard values, and rebuilding the same projector at the same head reproduces the digest.

steps.title: Bind one evidence-gated promotion and autonomy-widening decision to rollout, ablation, coverage, receipt, and rollback closure
steps.rationale: The early supervised milestone verifies a non-serving candidate and preserves the production incumbent; only this later adapter may request production rollout activation or unattended authority widening. Model, composition, mechanism, routing, steering, code, and automation evidence feeds one typed promotion request; documents named promotion remain evidence only. The adapter derives the exact promotion effect, action-bound inspection, task or DelegatedAgentInvocation ceiling, active AutomationPolicyLifecycle standing grant or argument-bound HumanDecision, and shared StageReceipt after rollout, incumbent, candidate, ablation, coverage, rollback, causal closure, and beneficial special-cause evidence from the frozen sequential-control plan are present, then submits the request to the already-established shared lifecycle owner. Common-cause or insufficient evidence preserves the current grant; adverse special cause may only narrow or stop. Unattended authority is an exact predicate and set lattice, never a scalar: adding a mutation kind, capability, or target, relaxing a predicate, or increasing a budget is widening and traverses that same lifecycle compare-and-set with rollout evidence and rollback. Plugin-specific learning, calibration, and safety requirements remain typed evidence inputs. StageReceipt binds the exact arguments, effect, and active policy identity whose predicate admitted that invocation; no caller boolean, second approval document, or promotion-specific transition owner is authority.

items.title: Contain, narrow, quarantine, roll back, and re-admit through the same shared promotion lifecycle

steps.title: Establish the shared distribution-free Phase I and Phase II sequential-control owner
steps.rationale: Create the one cross-domain content-addressed sequential-control plan; live safety is its first consumer, not its owner. The plan binds statistic, direction, series key, incumbent reference history, ordered source identities, strata and regime, missing-data policy, residual or batch transform, compiled-Go method set and combination rule, a cost-bound target in-control run-length decision, coverage, and reopen triggers. Phase I calibrates only on stable incumbent history; Phase II applies the frozen plan and candidate observations cannot move their own limits. Compiled-Go evaluator plugins provide empirical-quantile or MAD Shewhart behavior for large shifts, rank or robust CUSUM for small sustained shifts, robust EWMA for drift, and empirically calibrated runs patterns. Calibrate the combined rule set so multiple charts do not silently inflate alarms. Assume neither IID, Gaussianity, stationarity, nor three-sigma limits: correlated streams require a bound residualizer or batch transform or time-ordered blocked replay; unsupported dependence or insufficient history remains calibration-only. Persist replay-measured empirical in-control run-length and ARL0 plus detection delay or ARL1 for predeclared shifts within the exact scope. Verdicts are insufficient, common-cause, beneficial-special-cause, or adverse-special-cause. Common cause and insufficient evidence create no lifecycle, budget, or autonomy request; deterministic integrity failures such as nonfinite values, mandatory telemetry absence, or corrupt identities may signal adverse special cause immediately but still have no mutation authority. Raw observations remain in the bounded chunk owner; projection checkpoints bind source head and cursor, and only calibration, reopen, and semantic verdict transitions become durable summaries.

steps.title: Turn sustained regression evidence into lifecycle-authorized containment and autonomy narrowing
steps.rationale: Publish advisory, finding, and requested containment evidence only from adverse special-cause evidence under the frozen sequential-control plan or a deterministic integrity failure; common cause and insufficient evidence cannot request action. The circuit breaker is evidence-only: it submits a typed contained or rolled-back transition, or an already-admitted restrictive-policy transition, to the single shared lifecycle owner. AutomationPolicyLifecycle and ExperimentLifecycle become scoped adapters and projections, not mutation authorities. Runtime treats contained policy as granting no unattended mutation. Narrowing may remove mutation kinds, capabilities, targets, or budgets and tighten predicates; it can never widen. A classifier or domain evaluator cannot mutate state, create a parallel safety ceiling, or own a second lifecycle. Every containment or retry still binds the exact effect, arguments, action-specific inspection, active policy or HumanDecision authority, and shared StageReceipt.

steps.title: Rollback the active candidate and unattended grant atomically through the shared lifecycle compare-and-set
steps.rationale: Only the shared lifecycle owner can change active state. Health classifications, MoE comparisons, scaling evidence, operator decisions, and ExperimentLifecycle records remain immutable inputs or scoped projections. The rollback adapter derives the exact rollback effect and arguments, action-bound inspection, task or delegation ceiling, active already-admitted rollback policy or argument-bound HumanDecision, and shared admitted-running-terminal StageReceipt, then submits one transition request; the common owner publishes terminal receipt and alias compare-and-set atomically. Concurrent promotion, containment, rollback, or operator action has one winner; stale decisions refuse and preserve their evidence without overwriting a newer head.

steps.title: Require fresh evidence and normal promotion authority before any contained candidate or autonomy grant re-enters rollout
steps.rationale: Restart, replay, alias repair, or another controller proposal cannot clear quarantine or restore a wider unattended grant. Reentry names the prior finding and lifecycle transition, changed mechanism, fresh role-specific mechanism evidence for the exact subject, new evaluation and coverage, applicable assumption or classifier reopen triggers, an applicable frozen sequential-control plan, an existing AdmissionBinding, decider, and fresh rollout plan. A regime or mechanism change requires fresh Phase I calibration unless exact evidence proves the existing plan remains applicable. Mechanism admission restores candidate eligibility only; any autonomy widening traverses AutomationPolicyLifecycle, the promotion adapter supplies evidence, and only the shared lifecycle owner can activate.

items.title: Prove one Go-only candidate, promotion, driver, and UTCP spine over the modular store

steps.title: Install the shared-spine entry ratchet before opening the post-proof frontier
steps.rationale: Immediately after the supervised proof, extend the early always-required, manifest-owned gate ratchet over the four shared components: Candidate admission, promotion and rollback lifecycle, evidence DriverDecision, and transport-neutral invocation effect, authority, and StageReceipt, while reserving the one shared sequential-control owner used by safety, autonomy, health, and efficiency. Every later implementation slice must extend this permanent ratchet when it adds an entry point; this row installs the boundary before that post-proof construction rather than discovering bypasses at closure. Domain plugins may prepare typed specifications, realizations, evaluator facts, statistics, or requests but cannot own a second admission, lifecycle, driver, transport registry, approval, receipt, calibration, detector, action, or publication path. Prove mechanism evidence is subject-relevant, dataset transforms cannot execute callables, router aliases cannot activate, documents named promotion cannot mutate, common-cause classifications cannot request action, classifiers cannot contain without lifecycle authority, all training-launch, promotion, activation, containment, retry, and rollback mutations use the common contract, and deterministic internal Go never invokes UTCP transport. No second guard process or policy owner is introduced.

steps.title: Seal the Go-only plugin and UTCP boundary before post-proof expansion
steps.rationale: Re-run and seal the same early Go-only ratchet over the proven vertical slice before opening the post-proof plugin and peer frontier. Every later slice extends this always-required census with its own surface in the producing commit. Prompts and descriptions remain typed artifact data, but Markdown skills, plugin manifests, embedded interpreters, runtime scripts, and filesystem discovery cannot grant capabilities or alter runtime semantics; UTCP resolution remains outward or agent-facing and deterministic in-process owners remain direct Go. No duplicate check is introduced.

steps.title: Rebuild a legacy store into segmented journal, blob, and projection layout and execute backup, restore, retention, and rollback drills
steps.rationale: Use a pinned compatibility and scale corpus containing candidates, promotion lifecycles, DriverDecisions, StageReceipts, bounded router and health chunks, sequential-control plans, calibration evidence, projection checkpoints and verdict digests, scaling, interaction, peer invocation, and rollout evidence. Rebuild segmented journal, blob, projections, aliases, and checkpoints without decoding raw blobs during metadata replay; compare query, summary, raw-content, receipt, lifecycle, control, and lineage digests; inject interruption at every publication boundary; and prove backup, restore, retention, compaction, read-only open, and source recovery.

steps.title: Run one composite candidate through admission, realization, ablation, promotion, driving, peer inspection, containment, rollback, and explanation
steps.rationale: Acceptance requires externally visible control behavior, not only new record types. Run one bounded unattended multi-strategy campaign, accumulating exact strategy-tagged attempt and experiment evidence, around a composite Candidate combining a subject-relevant mechanism, deterministic dataset transform, model or composition change, MoE routing component, and inspection steering direction through the single AdmissionBinding owner, registered Go realization plugins, exact strategy identity, semantically relevant typed references, component and joint ablations, bounded isolated scaling and phase-bound training-health evidence, scope-complete bounded router observations, exact controller checkpoint resume, and multidimensional fitness. Prove dataset stages stay within memory and intermediate-storage budgets and resume exactly with retained failure classification. Derive an explicit expert-parallel refusal when no single-device scale blocker exists; if the blocker and distributed target are admitted, prove one bounded evidence-selected transport against the local reference with separated router semantics, capacity and drop evidence, and exact checkpoint and retry recovery. Promote through the shared lifecycle and exact autonomy-widening evidence; drive under resource and interaction budgets, saturation, and stop; invoke one hermetic enrolled-peer http-json-stream inspection capability with an exact StageReceipt; force alpha zero whenever mutation is exposed; retain failed, null, missing, and degraded outcomes under shared fact, chunk, and raw-byte budgets. Inject common-cause noise and prove no lifecycle or autonomy mutation, then inject a predeclared sustained adverse shift and prove sequential-control evidence to lifecycle-authorized containment, atomic rollback, and reproducible causal explanation after cold rebuild without external services. The same fixture closes race, interrupted restart, browser-visible operation state, device selection and failure, and release verification paths. Every training launch, promotion, activation, containment, retry, and rollback binds exact effect, arguments, action-specific inspection, task or delegation ceiling, active policy or HumanDecision, and StageReceipt. Domain evidence cannot activate itself.

steps.title: Re-run common-code and policy-copy census and record the campaign tightening delta
steps.rationale: The campaign closes only if the four shared components and one sequential-control owner replace repeated candidate, admission, evaluation, driver, lifecycle, invocation, process, publication, failure, retry, capability, trigger, resource, query, reconciliation, training-observation, calibration, threshold, window, persistence, detector, and storage mechanics. Re-run the clone, ownership, magic, source-modernization, staged-surface, and mechanism censuses through their existing owners. Refuse copied Marin or other source-plan constants and assumptions, advisory identity leaks into authority, competing plan files or free-text future-work triggers, and deferred or rejected mechanisms without evidence-bound reopen or retirement triggers.
